title: Choose the landing page structure
question: Same BukiMart look (navy on white, ID-card listings). Three ways to lay out the page; pick one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The Enrollment Slip
options.thesis: The page reads like a campus registration slip you fill top to bottom: Step 1 sign up, Step 2 post or browse, Step 3 message.
options.viewport: Headline and both buttons on the left; on the right a filled-in slip showing a real listing's fields and a Message button.
options.risk: If the form metaphor is overdone it can feel like paperwork instead of a quick marketplace.

regions.label: what you can sell: 4 slip fields

options.label: The Lanyard Rack
options.thesis: The first thing you see is a rack of sample ID-card listings hanging from lanyards, so the page shows the product instead of describing it.
options.viewport: Short headline above a row of 4-5 swinging sample cards (uniform, shoes, book, a service, a swap), buttons under the rack.
options.risk: Sample cards must be clearly labeled as examples, and the rack scrolls sideways on phones.

options.label: The Province Map
options.thesis: Bukidnon drawn as a simple route map with towns as stops, making the cross-campus reach the first idea.
options.viewport: Headline over a stylised line map (Malaybalay, Valencia, Maramag and more) with one sample card pinned to a stop; buttons under it.
options.risk: A map implies coverage data we don't have; it must stay schematic, not claim real listing counts.

regions.label: Bukidnon route map, towns as stops
